messages:
elaine (partnerships): Heads-up: Partner Beta changed their plan tiers mid-month and wants prorated credits for customers. Their exporter sent two snapshots for the same accounts (pre-change and post-change). We need a safe way to reconcile and ensure billing correctness.

chris (eng-data): quick Q: are the snapshots full-state (account-level totals) or delta events? That changes approach.

elaine (partnerships): full-state snapshots per tenant for the hour ending. They include entitlement_id, plan_id, and total_units.

noah (billing): if snapshots are full-state we can diff successive snapshots to compute deltas, but we must be careful with plan tier boundaries. Proration should use the exact time of plan switch and hourly granularity may not be precise enough.

tara (finance): for revenue recognition we need deterministic rules. Proposal: use event_time from partner change webhook as authoritative switch timestamp. If not present, fall back to snapshot mid-point. Any back-dated plan changes >30 days require manual review.

chris (eng-data): technical proposal: ingest both snapshots with provenance tags (snapshot_id, exported_at). For each account, match snapshots by entitlement_id then compute unit_delta = snap2.total_units - snap1.total_units. Also compute overlap with plan effective windows and apply per-second prorate weight when we have exact switch timestamp.

sam (qa): edgecases: partner may resend snapshots that differ slightly due to rounding. We should implement a tolerance threshold (e.g., 0.5%) where small diffs are considered noise and not trigger ledger churn.

noah (billing): ledger workflow: for each computed delta, emit a pending credit record with metadata: reason=plan-prorate, source_snapshot_ids, switch_timestamp_source. Pending credits go through a dry-run in staging before ledger write. Approvals needed for >$1k per account.

elaine (partnerships): partner asked for a reconciliation report showing per-account before/after snapshots, computed delta, prorated amount, and any manual flags. They want CSV weekly for first month.

chris (eng-data): ingest schema suggestion:
POST /marketplace/snapshot
{ "snapshot_id":"snap-20260315-01", "exported_at":"2026-03-15T02:00:00Z", "rows":[{"entitlement_id":"ent-123","plan_id":"pro","total_units":12345}], "source":"beta-exporter" }
We store row-level provenance and compute diffs in a windowed job.

tara (finance): also require that partner include a signed manifest for snapshots (HMAC) so we can prove authenticity if a dispute arises. Ledger entries should reference manifest_id.

sam (qa): test cases: identical snapshots, snapshot with small noise, snapshot with genuine increase, snapshot with plan switch mid-window, and missing switch timestamp. I'll produce vectors.

chris (eng-data): ops note: windowed diff job will be O(N) per partner per snapshot. For high-frequency exporters we need to gate processing or sample. We'll add a tunable backlog limit.

noah (billing): one more: if partner sends both pre and post snapshots for same hour, prefer the one with later exported_at unless partner indicates an authoritative switch event. Document that in API contract.

elaine (partnerships): next steps: 1) eng to add snapshot endpoint + provenance (chris) 2) billing/finance to sign off on proration rules and approval thresholds (noah/tara) 3) QA to provide test vectors (sam) 4) partnerships to coordinate weekly CSV delivery for partner beta (elaine). Target: staging test in 7 days.

audit-bot: snapshot-ingest job queued: snapshot-diff-run-2026-03-16 scheduled.
